import matplotlib
matplotlib.use('Agg')
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import matplotlib.ticker as mticker
import numpy as np

plt.rcParams.update({
    'font.family': 'DejaVu Sans',
    'font.size': 11,
    'axes.titlesize': 13,
    'axes.labelsize': 12,
    'xtick.labelsize': 10,
    'ytick.labelsize': 10,
    'legend.fontsize': 10,
    'figure.dpi': 300,
    'savefig.dpi': 300,
    'savefig.bbox': 'tight',
    'savefig.pad_inches': 0.05,
    'axes.spines.top': False,
    'axes.spines.right': False,
    'lines.linewidth': 1.8,
})

# Okabe-Ito colorblind-friendly palette
OI_BLUE = '#0072B2'
OI_ORANGE = '#D55E00'
OI_GRAY = '#999999'
OI_BLUE_LIGHT = '#0072B2'

# Data
eps = np.array([0.03, 0.05, 0.10, 0.20, 0.30, 1.42])
obs_only = np.array([16, 13, 19, 22, 19, 17])
perdof = np.array([14, 14, 11, 11, 4, 0])
baseline = 12

fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(7, 4.5))

# Fill "always safe" region between obs_only and baseline
ax.fill_between(eps, baseline, obs_only, where=(obs_only >= baseline),
                alpha=0.12, color=OI_BLUE, zorder=1)

# Baseline reference line
ax.axhline(y=baseline, color=OI_GRAY, linestyle='--', linewidth=1.2, zorder=2)
ax.text(0.032, baseline + 0.6, 'argmin / VLA-only = 12%',
        fontsize=9, color=OI_GRAY, va='bottom')

# obs_only line
ax.plot(eps, obs_only, 'o-', color=OI_BLUE, markersize=7, label='obs_only CRM',
        zorder=4, markeredgecolor='white', markeredgewidth=0.8)

# perdof line
ax.plot(eps, perdof, '^-', color=OI_ORANGE, markersize=7, label='perdof CRM',
        zorder=4, markeredgecolor='white', markeredgewidth=0.8)

# Peak annotation for obs_only
ax.annotate('22% ($\\varepsilon$=0.2)',
            xy=(0.20, 22), xytext=(0.28, 24.5),
            fontsize=9.5, fontweight='bold', color=OI_BLUE,
            arrowprops=dict(arrowstyle='->', color=OI_BLUE, lw=1.2),
            zorder=5)

# "always safe" label
ax.text(0.085, 14.2, 'always $\\geq$ baseline',
        fontsize=8.5, color=OI_BLUE, fontstyle='italic',
        ha='center', zorder=5)

# Catastrophic collapse annotation for perdof
ax.annotate('catastrophic\ncollapse',
            xy=(0.55, 2), xytext=(0.65, 9),
            fontsize=9, fontweight='bold', color=OI_ORANGE,
            ha='center',
            arrowprops=dict(arrowstyle='->', color=OI_ORANGE, lw=1.2),
            zorder=5)

# Shade the collapse region
ax.axvspan(0.25, 1.6, alpha=0.06, color=OI_ORANGE, zorder=0)

# Axes
ax.set_xscale('log')
ax.set_xlabel('Max Correction Norm ($\\varepsilon$)')
ax.set_ylabel('Success Rate (%)')

# Custom x-ticks at data points
ax.set_xticks(eps)
ax.get_xaxis().set_major_formatter(mticker.ScalarFormatter())
ax.set_xticklabels(['0.03', '0.05', '0.10', '0.20', '0.30', '~1.42\n(uncon.)'],
                    fontsize=9)
ax.minorticks_off()

# Y-axis
ax.set_ylim(-1, 28)
ax.set_yticks(range(0, 28, 4))
ax.yaxis.set_major_formatter(mticker.PercentFormatter(decimals=0))

# Legend
ax.legend(loc='upper right', frameon=True, framealpha=0.9,
          edgecolor='#cccccc', fancybox=False)

# Title
ax.set_title('Correction Magnitude vs. Task Performance', pad=12)

plt.tight_layout()

out_base = '/root/acr-vla-conformal-refinement/figures/magnitude_curve_obs_vs_perdof'
fig.savefig(out_base + '.pdf')
fig.savefig(out_base + '.png')
print(f"Saved: {out_base}.pdf and .png")
PYEOF
